title: Purposes, uses, advantages and disadvantages of statistical representations
summary: Select a representation that matches the data, audience and comparison task.
objectives: Match tables and graphs to their main purposes.
Explain the strengths and limits of each representation.
Choose a display using the structure of the data and the reader's needs.

blocks.text: Tables preserve exact values; bar graphs compare categories; pictograms offer an accessible visual summary; line graphs reveal change over an ordered variable such as time; pie charts emphasise a few parts of one whole. Selection depends on the task, not decoration.
